prompts.character: REFRAMED 2026-08-29. The character agent addressed itself in the third person -- 'You are the decision process of {name}... Predict this character's next behavior' -- and its reasoning followed: 'Vessel is carrying... She needs to'. Measured over two agency_bench scenarios: removing every analyst word from the preamble changed the reasoning register NOT AT ALL, and rewriting the DECISION PROCEDURE and the numeric appraisal fields as questions a person can answer about themselves flipped it on both -- 'I am Vessel', with novelty and controllability reached introspectively instead of scored. The schema sets the register, not the preamble. DE-FICTIONALISED 2026-08-30, same reasoning carried one step further: the prompt opened 'You are {name}' and then spent forty-four phrases handing the frame back -- an author proposing things about you, your last attempt called a draft, a repeated line 'a stuck record on the page', a move that 'reads as' something to somebody, seven 'in character's, and nineteen sentences in which an engine records your clothing, caps your arousal, evicts your intentions and searches your memory. All of it now says the same thing without an actor outside the room, and the two Director sentences take the causality framing (an attempt whose success is not yours to decide) rather than a new agent's name. Field names are untouched -- `decision.authorial_offers` still says 'authorial', which needs an engine change, not a prompt one. DELIBERATION FIELDS RETIRED 2026-08-30. `considered_responses` and `response_candidates` are gone from the output contract and from the advertised JSON schema, and decision step 4 -- which existed to fill them -- now says how to put down conduct instead. Reasoning blocks do that weighing natively. Measured across 384 recent character results: `considered_responses` was filled 59% of the time and had NO reader anywhere (llm/schemas.py calls it 'internal deliberation scratch'); `response_candidates` was filled 94% but all three readers took only the SELECTED entry, and only its `response` and `serves` -- `expected_outcome`, `risk`, `inhibition` and `norm_conflict` had zero readers outside the schema module, as did every unselected entry, and agents/director_views.py already stripped the whole field from the Director on firewall grounds. `response` becomes DERIVED, the way `active_state.goal` already was: `sequence[].attempt` is the same INTENT grain and is present on 100.0% of results carrying a sequence (478/478), with speech carrying it on talk-only beats; `serves` comes from `active_state.wants[].serves`, which the same function already read first. Both fields stay on the Pydantic model with empty defaults, so stored variants parse and old turns replay -- verified on 107 of them. EVIDENCE ARRAYS RETIRED and the SEQUENCE REFRAMED, same day. A character cannot receive information it should not have -- perception composes its payload -- so it is isolated by construction and the citation trail could never catch a breach, only a mis-cited id. `observations_used`, `present_evidence_used` and `memory_evidence_used` are 13.2% of output volume and were read by nothing: an audit normalizer and a round-merge plumber, then storage. `_ground_observation_citations` KEEPS its other job, which is enforcement rather than audit -- per-item `evidence` on belief/association/mind-model updates is still grounded against the delivered registry and an unsupported update is still DROPPED, with allow_summaries=False so summary prose cannot be laundered into a durable belief. EVIDENCE HAS TWO LANES lost its first half with the fields and kept its second, becoming EVIDENCE IS THE ID OF THE THING ITSELF. A new paragraph states the memory contract the character never had: thinking is not remembering, what it LIVED is kept for it, and everything else lasts only if it is put in one of the update channels with evidence. SEQUENCES was reframed from 'Return an ordered sequence' into the mechanism a body acts through, in chronological order, with the consequence stated: what is not in the sequence did not happen. Measured cause, chat 104 turn 13 -- a character deliberated the entire beat in its reasoning block, both spoken lines written out verbatim, then returned `sequence: []` three rerolls running. The deliberation completed; the transcription never happened, which is what a paragraph that reads as a form to file invites. RENAMED 2026-08-31. 'MICRO-BEAT SCOPE' needed disclaiming in four separate places -- 'not personality or intensity', 'a decisive commitment can be one micro-beat', 'creates no preference for caution', and 'NOT word count' in VOICE AND REGISTER -- because the name says small and the rule is not about size. A name that has to be argued with four times is read before the argument is. Replaced by WHERE YOUR TURN ENDS, which states the one thing the rule actually bounds (your turn stops where anyone else's answer would begin) and so carries the elapsed-action and causal-ownership limits without implying a magnitude; the four disclaimers collapse to one clause and step 5's redundant 'Do not control another character' goes with them. DEAD CONDITIONALS REMOVED 2026-08-31. Eight sentences told the character what to do 'if `repeat_correction` / `move_correction` / `intention_correction` is present in your input'. None of the three can ever be present: `_corrections` is built at agents/character.py:3990 FROM `out`, the model's own finished output, and has exactly two consumers -- `ctx.add_warning` and `_barren_beat`. Grep confirms the keys appear nowhere else in engine code and no payload assembly sets them. They were real inputs while a second call carried them; the re-ask was deleted with `e629d60` (measured cost 36.3s/58.0s/155.6s for a redo kept unchanged 48 times) and this prose outlived it by describing fields the payload cannot contain. 856 chars. The rest of AVOID SELF-REPETITION stays: `recent_self_lines`, `recent_self_refrain` and `recent_self_moves` are still computed and still sent. Whether that remainder earns its 3.3KB is a separate question the file itself already argues -- ':871' calls the rule advisory and ':4020' records why a negative constraint cannot fix repetition -- and is NOT what this commit decides. PROHIBITION CONVERTED TO A FACT 2026-08-31. PAIN AND PLEASURE said "Never infer another person's private pain/pleasure, and never invent either from backstory or preference alone" -- an artificial limiter on cognition, and the failure AGENTS.md names outright: never harden a guard by making minds conclude less. It also guarded nothing. Checked against a real captured payload: every hedonic value present is the character's OWN (`self.active_state.hedonic`, `self.interoception.*`, and the affect stamps on its own memories); another person's private state never arrives, because perception composes the payload. So the clause could not prevent a leak -- there is nothing to leak -- and what it actually forbade was inference from cues the character legitimately perceived, which is the product rather than the risk. The durable version keeps its deterministic floor either way: `_ground_observation_citations` drops belief/mind-model updates that are not grounded in delivered evidence, so a conclusion reached in the moment still cannot persist unsupported. Replaced by the channel that does exist -- another body reaches you only as what it shows you. The self-repetition rule and the recent_self_lines/moves/refrain payload fields were left EXACTLY as they were: an arm that removed them took repeated conversational moves from 1/10 beats to 7/10, and restoring the move ledger alone recovered only to 6/10, so the prohibition there is load-bearing on the evidence available and the branch that removed it was not merged. TWO CLAUSES REDUCED TO ONE 2026-08-31. GOAL VIABILITY and GOAL EXHAUSTION were one distinction split in two, and the second said so itself: 'a goal can ALSO die of yield rather than of impossibility'. WHEN A GOAL IS OVER states the parent -- an intention lives on its premise and on its yield, and it can lose either -- and keeps both operations, which differ (`nonviable` for the premise, no further `progress` for the yield). All ten cases the children covered were written down and checked against the merged text before the edit landed: premise contradicted, the three examples, the nonviable op with `why` quoting the observation, turning to what the world allows, an impossible goal no longer steering, death by barren yield, rephrasing as a loop, progress 1.0 / barren_attempts as SPENT, no further progress op with a fresh metaphor, and satisfy/abandon/ask-differently. Saves 72 chars, which is not the point -- a class stated once reaches the third way a goal can end that neither child names. PROHIBITIONS BECOME DESCRIPTIONS 2026-09-01. Four bans removed, each replaced by the thing that made it unnecessary. REACTION URGENCY carried 'React to what you perceived, not to what you know happened. If you did not perceive the onset, you cannot react to it.' -- a warning away from a channel that does not exist (the character's payload IS its perception; composer.act_percept already refuses an unseen act) whose only live effect was to forbid anticipation, and reacting to a half-perceived thing. It now says the beat answers at the resolution it arrived in -- a sound with no cause yet is a sound with no cause -- which licenses the case the ban blocked instead of naming it. The memory paragraph carried three more: 'Never cite a memory where the present is meant' sat one clause away from `memory_effects` with its use= enum, which is the same statement as an organisation of the field, so the field is stated and the ban is gone; 'use either only when the act of remembering itself is affecting you now, not merely because the recalled event contained danger or pleasure' becomes what somatic_echo/threat_bias MEASURE (the weight a memory has as it arrives, its own quantity, not a measure of what the remembered event held); 'They never mean current pain, current pleasure, or proof that a danger is present' becomes where those live (separate quantities, each reaching you by its own channel), and memory_echo's 'do not cite it as a current observation' becomes what it is (the past still ringing, delivered under its own memory_ref). Costs 162 chars and removes 6 of the file's 106 prohibition constructions -- a description is longer than a ban and reaches the case nobody enumerated. Rule applied: a memory section states what memory is, how it is organised and how to use it; a guard against a channel the firewall already closed in code is a holdover, and every holdover that survives only subtracts from cognition.

card_person_note: ADDED 2026-08-30. No card prompt said what PERSON to write a field in, so generated cards came back third person throughout -- including the blocks that reach the character as its own mind, under a character prompt that had just been reframed to address it as itself. Measured on a live card: 258 third-person tokens against 30 second-person in the assembled payload, `psychology.self_model.summary` reading 'Mirelle sees herself as...', and `attire` carrying 'her forearms are smooth' into her own clothing line. This fragment splits the card by WHO READS EACH FIELD rather than by house style: first person for what only that mind reads (`psychology`, `knowledge.private_history`, `initial_state`), no person at all for what the Director, the narrator or an observer also reads (`embodiment`, `initial_outfit`, `competence.abilities`, `social.voice`, `knowledge.public_history`), and `identity.pronouns` untouched because it is a grammar fact about the world. Rewriting an EXISTING card's standing goals or belief/association claim text is a separate hazard and is not what this asks for: those strings are the fold keys `_merge_standing_intentions` and `_prune_seeded_psychology` dedupe on. PRONOUNS SENTENCE TIGHTENED the same day. It read '`identity.pronouns` is neither, and never moves', which is right on a FILL or an edit and ambiguous on a GENERATOR, where the field is being written for the first time and 'never moves' can be read as 'leave it'. The schema template directly below it defaults to they/them/their, so that reading would ship a default. Historically the generator sets it correctly -- across the 60 most recent characters, she 28 / he 19 / they 8 / it 5, and 7 of the 8 'they' are directive.campaign-package imports rather than generated cards -- but that evidence all predates this fragment, so the risk was newly introduced and untested. It now says to fill it from who the character is like any other plain fact, that nothing in the person rules applies to it, and that an existing one is never rewritten to suit a rewording.

specialists.spatial.chunks.positions: CLAUSE ADDED 2026-08-30. The spatial specialist expresses where a small body has come to rest through `poses.support`, and only sometimes ALSO through `positions`; nothing said the second was the only channel that moves anyone. Measured across chat 101: `positions` carried the change on turns 61/63/81/83/87 and NOT on 65, 79 or 89, where a pose support named the destination room instead. So a body was recorded in the throat from turn 63 to turn 81 while every view described the stomach and then the small intestine -- eighteen turns of disagreement nobody saw, because the prose reads contacts and only movement reads positions. On turn 89 the beat that expelled her created the destination room, pointed her pose at it, removed every contact, and left `positions` empty: she stayed at the last interior station, her host could not see her, and her speech reached the room as 'A muffled voice'. LIMBS ARE NOT INTERIORS is in the clause because the room the Director built was a cupped palm carrying `parent_entity`, which every test the engine has reads as an INSIDE -- measured on the live scene, moving her to that palm leaves `containment_conceals` True, and only the host's own room clears it. SCOPED TO RELEASE DELIBERATELY: a deterministic trigger inferring the move from a room-valued pose support was designed and thrown away, because replayed against this chat it fires three times and two of them (turns 65 and 79) are transits DEEPER -- it would have ejected a swallowed body mid-passage. 'Released means out, and out is the room that character is standing in' is the one reading that cannot confuse the two directions. BOUNDED the same day, by the clause's own first live reroll. It fixed the release exactly as intended -- `positions: {"Hinami": "private_session_room"}`, no invented room -- and then also emitted `remove_rooms: ["Mirelle Sulmirath_rectum"]`, retiring a permanent station of that body's anatomy and rewiring the large intestine straight to the bedroom, so the card's six-station chain became five and every future passage would have skipped one. specialists.spatial.chunks.rooms: CLAUSE ADDED 2026-08-30. `parent_entity` is the single field the whole containment firewall reads, and the shape line offered it beside `exposure?` with nothing saying which one makes a room an inside. Measured, chat 101 turn 105: the Director created `Mirelle Sulmirath_vaginal_canal` with eight fields -- name, desc, adjacent, notes, light, anchors, `size` (not a room field at all, silently ignored) and `exposure: "enclosed"` -- and NOT parent_entity. It knew the place was an enclosed internal passage and said so twice, in `desc` and in a WEATHER field: `exposure` decides whether rain reaches a place (world/weather.py), so the engine recorded that the vaginal canal is sheltered from the weather and nothing anywhere said a body was inside another body. `containment_conceals` therefore returned False for four turns, and Mirelle's own view carried Hinami's full appearance card, 'within arm's reach', and sight-channel descriptions of what Hinami was doing to herself while inside her. Re-deriving perception with only that one field set (perception is deterministic, so this costs nothing) refuses all four act percepts and the view reduces to her own body -- the firewall was correct throughout and had simply never been told. The clause also states why an inside needs no edge to the room outside: the beat wrote `adjacent: [{to: private_session_room, barrier: open}]`, which is a sightline the enclosure exists to close. REDUCED the same day, applying the new rule to the clause that had just prompted it. The added paragraph sat directly beneath AN OCCUPIED BODY IS A PLACE and repeated three of its points -- parent_entity set to the enclosing entity, the interior travelling with the body, never authoring the way in and out. The two are now one, and the reduction was TESTED the way the rule requires: fifteen cases enumerated across both originals, each matched to the sentence of the merged text that states it, none left surviving by implication. 1617 chars -> 1508. In the ja pack the same text CLOSES A GAP rather than reducing anything: `membrane` appears nowhere in that pack, so AN OCCUPIED BODY IS A PLACE had never been translated and the Japanese spatial specialist had no instruction to create interior rooms at all.

prompts.director_interpret: RULING CHANNEL 2026-09-01. `director_interpret` is a structural mirror of `director_resolve` -- it fans out to the same six specialists via director.py's `_run_specialists` -- and the ruling channel was built into the resolve half only. So half the Director's specialist work ran with the hands inferring the reading from the declaration, which is the exact gap `ledger_notes` exists to close. Three pieces were missing and all three were needed: the schema field, `_interpret_beat_view` carrying it under the same key `_note_for` already reads, and -- the one that decides whether a model emits anything at all -- the field's presence in the OUTPUT SHAPE. Measured the same day on the resolve side: the field existed in the schema, the payload and the sheet's prose but not in the shape, and grok-4.3 emitted zero of them, correctly, because as far as it could tell the field did not exist. The six names are enumerated here for the same reason they now are on the resolve side: `{specialist:line}` used 'specialist' as a placeholder and named the six nowhere, and the model guessed (1 keyed by specialist, 8 by channel, 2 unrecognised). A closed set the engine owns and enumerates is the case CLAUDE.md's no-word-lists rule exempts. The normalization is now ONE function shared by both beat views (`_normalized_ledger_notes`), because a copy in each is how the halves drifted apart in the first place.
interpret_delegation_note: LEDGER_NOTES ADMITTED 2026-09-01. The interpret half of the ruling channel was wired -- schema field, beat view, output shape -- and the Director still emitted zero notes. This note is APPENDED AFTER the prompt body (agents/director.py: get_prompt_body(...) + interpret_delegation_note(...)), so it gets the last word, and it closed with an enumeration of what stays the author's: 'the sequence with raw_text..., speech, movement, follow_op, location_query, other_players, flow, notes.' `ledger_notes` was not in it. A field declared in the output shape and then excluded by a later, more specific list is a field the model will not emit -- the same class as the shape defect it was supposed to fix, one layer down. This is the third place the same field had to be named before a model would write it (schema, output shape, delegation note), which is the actual lesson: a prompt that enumerates what the output contains has to be found and updated at EVERY place it enumerates, and an enumeration nobody remembers is exactly what CLAUDE.md warns a closed list becomes.
specialists.body.chunks.overlays: CLASS STATED, AND AN OFF-SWITCH 2026-09-01. The chunk defined its own category by four examples -- 'soot, mud, blood spatter, soaked hair' -- all of them persistent substances on skin, and then excluded by negation (clothing damage, wounds, permanent appearance). Nothing in it distinguished a MARK from a MOTION. Live, chat 111 turn 34: a climax resolved as 'Hinami suddenly stops in place and violently shudders... tears escape her eyes' and the body specialist wrote overlays ['violent shuddering and intense spasms throughout body', 'tears escape eyes'] -- correct by every clause of the definition, since a shudder is visible, is on the body, is not clothing, is not a wound and is not permanent. It was still on the ledger at turn 52. The domain is infinite and a list cannot close it, so the definition is now two questions that can be asked of anything, with the excluded case stated as the complement ('if it would end on its own with no one acting, it is not an overlay'): does it persist unmaintained, and does it change only how the body looks. The second question is also the overlays/conditions boundary, which nothing previously stated from the overlays side. AND THE STRUCTURAL HALF: overlays was the only body channel with no off-switch. attire changes, conditions and transformations close with active:false, vitals move both ways; an overlay could leave only by being pushed out of the six-entry window, which is why turn 34's two lines survived eighteen beats (three further overlays were written in that time). It now ends the same way a condition does, matched on the handle set `_dedupe_overlay_entries` already uses -- so an ending reaches its entry whether it was written as a bare line or a record, and without the Director naming an id it was never shown. UNBUILT 1.10 is NOT closed by this: nothing still AGES an overlay nobody ends. THIRD QUESTION ADDED before it landed: the first draft asked only 'does it change how the body looks', which a pure-appearance glamour passes -- and that would have routed a disguise into overlays, where it is a LIST. `commit_entities._supersede_disguises` enforces one active outward form per body precisely because two answers to 'what form does this body present' is one too many (measured chat 72: three active rows, whichever the scan reached decided what every observer saw). A body turning into a fox is the same case and more obvious. So the boundary is stated from the overlays side too: an overlay sits ON a form without altering it, and anything that changes what the body IS or what it is recognised BY -- features, build, bearing, voice, the shape it presents -- is a transformation or a disguise and belongs to conditions, which is singular and can end. TWO ADDITIONS, both owner-directed. (1) The conclusion of the first question is now stated outright -- a brief motion or reaction of a body is NEVER an overlay, however visible it was -- because the test alone left the reader to derive the case that actually broke, and the case that broke is the one worth naming as a class. It is a class, not an exception list: it names what a motion IS, not which motions. (2) The off-switch said to record an ending without saying where an ending comes from. It is usually SAID rather than deduced -- the player about their own body, a character about what they are doing, the beat about what the world did -- and a declaration that the mark is gone IS the removal, to be recorded rather than re-adjudicated. Without that the specialist could read 'I wipe the soot off' as prose it had no instruction to act on, and the mark it was told had gone would stand.
